capabilities: Create structured character notes with traits like role, faction, and secrets
Create location, faction, and lore entry notes with fixed fields
Record timeline events linked to characters and locations
Browse all entry types in a tabbed world sidebar
Configure the folder where world notes are stored
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a world/map drawing tool; it manages structured lore entries, not geographic visuals.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to organize fiction world-building entities (characters, locations, factions, lore, timeline) in a consistent, structured form.
summary: World-building toolkit that structures fiction settings into characters, locations, factions, lore entries, and timeline events with a sidebar view.
